target.title: fix(agents): contain async progress callback failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where an embedded-agent progress callback could reject after the subscription discarded its Promise, causing Node to treat a display or telemetry failure as an unhandled rejection and terminate the Gateway.

## Why This Change Was Made

All fire-and-forget assistant progress callbacks now contain synchronous throws and asynchronous rejections while preserving their best-effort delivery semantics. The existing tracked block-reply path is unchanged.

## User Impact

Users retain an active agent run when a progress, reasoning, partial-reply, typing, or tool-result presentation callback fails. The callback failure is logged rather than crashing the process.

## Evidence

- Added a focused regression test that rejects every assistant-progress callback category and asserts that no process-level unhandled rejection is emitted.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.block-reply-rejections.test.ts` passed: 3 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- AI-assisted; one repository autoreview pass completed with no accepted findings.
